info.title: Exciter
info.description: The requirements management HTTP API. Every endpoint answers JSON; errors share one envelope. Sign in with a session cookie or an API token sent as a bearer token.

get.summary: Who did what to the organization, newest first; next is the cursor for the window after, null at the end. For administrators.

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description: What kind of thing the entries are about, such as requirement or user.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The id of the thing the entries are about.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The first day, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, or the first instant with its zone.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The last day, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC and inclusive, or the instant the range ends before.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The next of the window before; the first window when absent.

default.description: An error, in the one shape every endpoint uses.

get.summary: The log as a CSV file, newest first, narrowed like the list; the export is itself recorded. Refused with export_too_large past 50000 entries. For administrators.
